audience: print shops that plan jobs, quotes and stock in Tharstern

useCases.title: Check jobs due this week
useCases.text: Search production jobs by number, customer, dates and progress flags, and read the milestone names of the jobs.

useCases.title: Follow estimates waiting for a decision
useCases.text: Search estimates by status, customer or dates, and read the customer record behind each one.

useCases.title: Price a product for a quantity
useCases.text: Read the price of one product for a quantity, optionally for one customer.

useCases.title: Check stock and open purchase orders
useCases.text: Read stock balances with their locations, and list purchase orders by status for the suppliers.

useCases.title: See what operators are working on
useCases.text: List shop-floor operators, and the operations they work on now or have worked on.

useCases.title: Review invoices and delivery notes
useCases.text: Search invoices by number, job, order or customer, and delivery notes by order, job or status.
